payload.title: Deployable legal coefficient candidate
payload.statement: A surface-free E003-style datum-plus-trend model can retain a material advantage, pass local packaging and exact reconstruction, and become deployment-ready after remote Kaggle parity.
payload.evidence_for: E004 geometry-plus-prefix reaches 15.4913 RMSE, improves all five maps, retains 0.3331 gain under spatial blocks, and has byte-identical direct/notebook submissions.
payload.evidence_against: The six surface columns driving E003 are absent from test. Surface-free gain shrinks from 4.9819 to 0.4185 RMSE, and remote Kaggle MCP parity is unavailable in the current tool environment.
payload.next_test: Execute notebooks/e004_deployment.ipynb through Kaggle MCP when available; do not submit the candidate solely from local 15.49 CV.
